name: scanner-qr-wedding-system
description: Sistem Check-In Tamu QR Code - Resepsi Pernikahan Wildan & Aisyah

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,SCANNER,DISPLAY" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run server" "npm run scanner" "npm run display"
scripts.all: concurrently -n "SERVER,SCANNER,DISPLAY,TUNNEL" -c "blue,green,magenta,cyan" "npm run server" "npm run scanner" "npm run display" "npm run tunnel:cf"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../scanner-app && npm install && cd ../display-app && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:scanner && npm run build:display
scripts.build:all: npm run install:all && npm run build
